newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Vilnius Bank climbs on active Lithuania bourse.
newsitem.headline: Vilnius Bank climbs on active Lithuania bourse.

text.p: Lithuanian shares edged higher led by leading bank Vilnius Bank on Friday on a market that was active, dealers said.
Vilnius Bank, the country's largest bank, rose to 148 litas from 143 litas on turnover of 600,000 litas.
It was the most traded of the day's overall central market volume of 956,000 litas and the group A index crept up by 2.90 points to 1,409.41.
Vilnius has been active recently after it split its shares to 50 litas nominal from 500 litas.
Fellow bank Hermis was also active on 215,000 litas of business and it slipped to 143.90 litas from 144 litas.
"Some investors who were buying into Hermis Bank while Vilnius Bank was splitting its shares seem to have switched back to Vilnius," said one trader.
Volume on the secondary T-bill market was more than one million litas and bloc trades worth 977,000 litas were carried out.
